claim: The rebrand uses Double Diamond divergence and convergence across Discover, Define, Develop, and Deliver.
Discovery combines goals, customer research, user profiles, journeys, values, personality, and positioning.
Research is synthesized into explicit design challenges before design exploration begins.
Develop begins with multiple stylescapes that coordinate the full visual direction before refinement.
Website, typography, color, photography, messaging, and product direction are refined in context.
Deliver converts the chosen direction into guidelines and applies it across web, packaging, studio, content, and product surfaces.
Confirms divergence and convergence are explicit at both problem and solution stages.
Shows discovery is collaborative and grounded in people close to customers and products.
Shows research is converted into structured user and perception artifacts.
Shows verbal identity is derived during definition, not appended after visual design.
Shows discovery outputs become explicit design challenges before solution exploration.
Shows a stylescape as a coordinated direction candidate rather than isolated component choices.
Confirms direction choice is made at a whole-system level before component refinement.
Shows the selected direction being tested against a real touchpoint.
Shows typography is selected in context, not as a detached font specimen.
Shows color decisions are validated in application rather than swatches alone.
Shows image direction is articulated as a range of visual behaviors.
Shows the chosen direction has been converted into a reusable system document.
Shows system rules include both tokens and an explanation of intended use.
Shows identity consistency across photographic and editorial components.
Shows the brand is validated beyond a style guide through channel applications.
Shows the same direction survives physical-space application.
Shows delivery as an integrated system review rather than a logo reveal.
Shows the identity driving a live digital product surface.
Shows the brand system changing the ongoing production environment.
